derivation.consequence: The HIGH tier of this taxonomy is E22's NEGATION trigger alone, so semantic-high-impact-error-rate-v1 under it is a strict LOWER BOUND on E22's own content-impact HIGH rate and must be quoted as the negation-critical rate, never as E22's 1.92 % agentic error rate. On Earnings-21 the digit trigger is carried by numeric-value-accuracy-v1 and the entity trigger by conec-entity-wer-official.
derivation.kind: mechanical projection of committed code; no new judgement
derivation.known_deviation: An INSERTED function word is LOW here and NONE in E22: an insertion is looked up as ("*", hypothesis word) and reaches the residual rule. Insertions carry zero reference-word mass, so no rate moves; they are reported separately in insertions_by_level.
derivation.projected_quantity: analysis.e22_error_taxonomy.semantic_impact, the span's own content_impact, restricted to one (reference word, hypothesis word) error instance

unrepresentable_triggers.why: an open class after Whisper normalization (2022, $1500000, 14.9%, 1st); a taxonomy key is an exact word, and a partial enumeration would silently score an unlisted number as ordinary wording. On Earnings-21 this trigger is carried by numeric-value-accuracy-v1.

E22's inventory is rebuilt per call from that call's own reference sentences; one static file cannot be per-call, and a union across calls would tag another call's names. On Earnings-21 this trigger is carried by conec-entity-wer-official, over ConEC's own gold entity tags.

format-convention, reference-convention and segmentation-artifact are NONE by ruling, and all three are decided by the 32-rule cascade from the utterance's neighbours, the segment table and the clip boundary. This export projects content_impact, the reading E22 publishes beside it.
